$comment: Authorization registry for Supabase Edge Functions (CLAUDE.md Standing Rule 6). Every function directory under supabase/functions/ must appear here. 'serviceRole' must match whether the function constructs a SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY client (verified by scripts/edge-authz-guard.mjs against source). A service_role function is a FAIL until reviewed:true with an authClass; user-reachable privileged classes (platform-admin, user-jwt) additionally require a runtime 'test' that exists on disk. Do NOT set reviewed:true or add a justification without a real authorization review in the PR — this file is the review artifact, not a suppression list.

authClasses.platform-admin: verified auth.getUser() + is_platform_admin() (platform_admins table). TEST REQUIRED.
authClasses.user-jwt: verified auth.getUser() + per-request org/role/ownership check before privileged ops. TEST REQUIRED.
authClasses.user-jwt-rls: forwards caller JWT; all data access runs under the caller's RLS (no service_role). Test recommended.
authClasses.api-key: hashed API key resolved to its own organization_id; all access scoped to that org. Test recommended.
authClasses.cron-secret: internal scheduler secret, timing-safe compare, fails closed if unset; no caller-named targets. Test recommended.
authClasses.public-proxy: stateless proxy, no DB writes, no tenant data.

holdings-api.justification: Authenticates a hashed hk_ key -> holdings_api_keys.organization_id; rejects 403 when portfolio.organization_id != key org; all writes key-org-scoped. Regression test recommended (follow-up).

ai-chat.justification: Publishable key + forwarded caller JWT + auth.getUser(); all context queries run under caller RLS; no service_role.

attention.justification: Forwards caller JWT; read-only; no service_role.

calendar-oauth-start.justification: OAuth start; forwards caller JWT; no service_role data access.

fetch-url-metadata.justification: Stateless URL metadata fetch; no DB.

yahoo-chart-proxy.justification: Global market chart proxy; no DB, no tenant data.

calendar-sync.note: Uses service_role + auth.getUser(); classify (user-jwt) and add a cross-user regression test before reviewed:true.

auto-archive.note: service_role, no visible caller gate; confirm cron-only + add a cron-secret gate/test before reviewed:true.

holdings-sftp-sync.note: service_role, no visible caller gate; confirm cron/system-only before reviewed:true.

market-events.note: service_role, global market data; confirm invocation gate before reviewed:true (low tenant risk).

market-news.note: service_role, global market data; confirm invocation gate before reviewed:true (low tenant risk).
